value.title: Aprile piovoso, maggio ventoso, anno fruttuoso.
value.synopsis: Fire Emblem and Sky High win the King of the Buddy Heroes title. Barnaby gets some exciting news, but he has to keep it a secret.

value.title: Chi non risica, non rosica.
value.synopsis: Little is yet known about the NEXT incident, but multiple theories abound. Everyone wants to know what's going on between Kotetsu and Karina.

value.title: Un amico si vede nel momento del bisogno.
value.synopsis: During a promo shoot, He Is Thomas declares his admiration for L.L. Audun. Then, the heroes are mobilized in response to an attack.

value.title: Chi ha i denti non ha il pane e chi ha il pane non ha i denti.
value.synopsis: As the "X" phenomenon spreads among NEXT throughout the city, Yuri gathers the heroes and gives them some bad news.

value.title: Vale più un testimone di vista che dieci di udito.
value.synopsis: The public has started to turn against all NEXT. Ryan thinks that a NEXT named Gregory Sunshine might be connected to the "X" phenomenon.

value.title: Non puoi insegnare al granchio a camminare diritto.
value.synopsis: Mattia wakes up in the hospital, but he claims to not remember anything that happened. There may be a NEXT with the ability to control other people.

value.title: La notte è più buia subito prima dell'alba.
value.synopsis: The Apollon heroes are all told to sign new contracts putting excessive restrictions on what they can do. Yuri shares a story about his father.

value.title: Nulla viene dal nulla.
value.synopsis: Before the heroes' evacuation, Agnes asks them to gather for one last farewell taping. But she might have something up her sleeve.

value.title: Gli eventi futuri proiettano la loro ombra nel passato.
value.synopsis: Gregory powers up the inmates of Abbas Prison and they start rampaging throughout the city. The heroes go rogue to stop them, despite the consequences.

value.title: Chi sta a vedere, ha due terzi del gioco.
value.synopsis: Gregory Sunshine has one last inmate to meet; a criminal with incredible powers. Meanwhile, the heroes struggle to neutralize the escaped NEXT.

value.title: L'unione fa la forza.
value.synopsis: Sigourney Rosicky reveals the reason for her vendetta against Little Aurora. The heroes get an unlikely ally in their fight against L. L. Audun.

value.title: Oggi non è solo lo ieri di domani.
value.synopsis: A powered up Tiger starts attacking Barnaby, who's left drained of power and vulnerable. Later, Tiger faces a sudden change.
